scripts.build: npm run build --workspace web && npm run build --workspace server
scripts.desktop: npm run build && npm run start --workspace desktop
scripts.desktop:pack: npm run build && npm run pack --workspace desktop
scripts.desktop:dist: npm run build && npm run dist --workspace desktop
scripts.desktop:smoke: npm run build && npm run smoke --workspace desktop
